zh: 我和新邻居相处得很愉快。
old_en: I get along well with my new neighbor.
new_en: I get along well with my new neighbor.

zh: 周末我和朋友相处得很融洽。
old_en: I get along nicely with my friends on weekends.
new_en: I get along well with my friends on weekends.

zh: 我们相处时可以多分享一些想法。
old_en: When we get along, we can share more ideas.
new_en: We can share more ideas when we get along.

zh: 我希望我们可以更好地相处。
old_en: I hope we can get along better.
new_en: I hope we can get along better.
